model.rationale: The baseline of R+19 rests on a strong R+21 lean plus incumbent and money advantages, and prediction markets agree at 98% Republican. Nothing in the dossier justifies moving away from that prior.

overview:
OH-02 is a heavily Republican southern Ohio district with a partisan lean of roughly R+21. Incumbent David Taylor won renomination and enters the general election with a clear financial advantage, having raised about $1.1 million, while Democrat Jennifer Mazzuckelli reports no fundraising figures. No public polls or expert ratings are available for this race, so the forecast relies on fundamentals.

Prediction markets give Taylor about a 98% chance of reelection, consistent with the quantitative baseline of a 19-point Republican margin. With no evidence of a competitive environment, this race is rated Safe Republican with high confidence.
